scope: Frozen Windows x64 C++/Qt/ConPTY product staging inputs for the termforge_qt_shell entry. This is an engineering candidate: not a released package, not an accepted R2 deliverable and not a redistribution clearance.

build.note: The Qt SDK, fixed ConPTY pair and fixed CRT are prepared by tools.prepare_qt_build. BUILD_TESTING only adds separate test output directories; no test executable belongs to this product staging.

qt_deployed.source_layout: Libraries must be byte-identical to <prepared-qt>/bin/<name>; plugins must be byte-identical to <prepared-qt>/plugins/<relative path>.

os_provided.name: icuuc.dll
os_provided.provider: Microsoft Windows 11 System32 ICU common forwarder
os_provided.reason: Qt6Core imports icuuc.dll, and windeployqt copies the developer machine's System32 forwarder into the build directory. The staged product must not redistribute or pin that OS component; the Windows 11 target supplies it at run time.
os_provided.verification: Staging requires the build copy to be byte-identical to the running system's System32 copy before excluding it. A copy from another source fails explicitly instead of being silently dropped.

excluded_system_redistributables.name: D3Dcompiler_47.dll
excluded_system_redistributables.reason: windeployqt --no-system-d3d-compiler; the Windows system D3D compiler is not pinned or redistributed in this package.

excluded_system_redistributables.name: dxcompiler.dll
excluded_system_redistributables.reason: windeployqt --no-system-dxc-compiler; the Microsoft DXC out-of-band redistributable is not pinned, and the Widgets raster entry does not link it.

excluded_system_redistributables.name: dxil.dll
excluded_system_redistributables.reason: windeployqt --no-system-dxc-compiler; the Microsoft DXC out-of-band redistributable is not pinned, and the Widgets raster entry does not link it.

test_fixture_policy: Staging admits only this contract and the pinned dependency manifests. Test executables (qt_*_test, qt_cpp_* smoke, shell_*_client), debug/link/log artifacts and any other unlisted file are rejected rather than copied.

ignored_build_artifacts.runtime-manifest.json: Derived inventory written into the same directory by tools/msvc_runtime.py manifest; it is evidence output, never part of the product staging.
